svg.title: Proposed design: Multi-client LLM gateway: heterogeneous clients and protocols through one governed core
svg.desc: Proposed composite gateway design, not a product feature guarantee. The accompanying Korean and English chapters explain policy, compatibility and failure limits.
svg.text: One entry point, many clients — protocol ingress · canonical core · protocol egress
Clients (each with its own wire protocol)
any SDK above, or Bedrock SDK
one Principal (team · user · key) · one policy
one audit chain · one cost ledger
Chat or Responses: check exact upstream API
* Claude InvokeModel requires anthropic_version, URI modelId and AWS auth.
† Preserve only for a matching Responses API and supported capabilities.
All paths inspect required transformations; unsupported semantics are rejected.
Stable converted prompts can warm a target cache; provider caches do not transfer.
Client quirks the gateway must absorb
Responses event stream ≠ Chat SSE; tool calls are
one process, two protocols — the same key must
resolve to the same team on both ingresses
OpenAI function calling; tool results return as
